title: Friedreich ataxia
summary: Friedreich ataxia affects the nerves that control movement and balance. Signs usually start in childhood or the teenage years and slowly get worse. It can also affect the heart.
inheritance_plain: It is inherited in an autosomal recessive way: a child is affected only if they get a changed copy of the FXN gene from both parents.
carrier_meaning: A carrier has one changed copy. Carriers are healthy and usually do not know they are carriers until they are tested.
disease_meaning: A person with two changed copies has Friedreich ataxia. Care from specialist teams, physiotherapy and heart checks help, and a treatment is now available for some people.
screening: A carrier test uses a blood or saliva sample. It looks for the most common changes and cannot find every possible change.

card_summary: Affects the nerves that control movement and balance. Carriers are healthy.
carrier_short: One changed copy. Healthy. Can pass the copy on.
disease_short: Two changed copies. Affects balance and movement, and sometimes the heart.
care: Specialist neurology and heart clinics, physiotherapy, genetic counselling and family support groups.
